capabilities: Search books by title, author or ISBN and create a note from the chosen result
Insert book metadata into the properties of the current note
Save cover images into the vault and reference them in properties
Fill notes from template files using Book Search-compatible variables
Import settings from the Book Search plugin
disambiguation: Not a reading or e-book tool; it only creates notes with metadata about books.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README documents exactly which hosts it contacts and states there is no telemetry or account.
intentEvidence: Book Lookup is a successor to Book Search.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to fetch book metadata from online catalogs, so making a note for a book means copying title, author, ISBN and cover by hand.
